mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.team_members (id, team_id, user_id, role, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{teamId}, #{userId}, #{role, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler}, #{status, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, team_id, user_id, role, status, created_at, updated_at FROM public.team_members WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1

SELECT tm.id, tm.team_id, tm.user_id, tm.role, tm.status, tm.created_at, tm.updated_at, u.email AS user_email, u.first_name AS user_first_name, u.last_name AS user_last_name FROM public.team_members tm INNER JOIN public.users u ON u.id = tm.user_id WHERE tm.team_id = #{teamId} AND tm.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY tm.created_at ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.team_members WHERE team_id = #{teamId} AND role = 'OWNER' AND status = 'ACTIVE'
SELECT team_id FROM public.team_members WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
